		CleanupID as string,
		SBSB_ID as string

	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR AS ContractNumber, MMR.CMS_RUN_DT AS RunDate, MMR.PAYMENT_DT AS PaymentDate, MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AS HICN, MMR.LAST_NM AS Surname, MMR.FRST_INIT_NM AS FirstInitial, MMR.SRC_MBR_GNDR_CD AS GenderCode, MMR.MBR_BRTH_DT AS DateofBirth, \' \' AS AgeGroup, MMR.STATE_COUNTRY_CD AS StateCountyCode, MMR.OUT_OF_AREA_IND AS OutofAreaInd, MMR.PART_A_ENTITLEMENT NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB, MMR.ADJ_REASON_CD AS AdjReasonCode, MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT AS PayAdjStartDate, MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT AS PayAdjEndDate, \' \' AS DemPayAdjRatePrtA, \' \' AS DemPayAdjRatePrtB, MMR.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_A AS MonPayAdjAmtRateA,  MMR.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_B AS MonPayAdjAmtRateB, MMR.ORIG_LOW_INCM_PREM_SBSDY_AMT AS LISPremSubsidy, MMR.MSP_ESRD AS ESRDMSPFlag, MMR.MTM_AMT AS MTM, \' \' AS Filler, MMR.MEDICAID_STS AS MedicaidSts, MMR.RAAG AS RiskAdjAgeGroup, \' \' AS PreviousDisableRatio, \' \' AS DeMinimis, \' \' AS DualPrtDEnrollSts, MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AS PBP, \' \' AS RaceCode, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_CD AS RiskAdjFacTypeCode, MMR.FRAILTY_IND AS FrailtyInd, MMR.OREC AS OREC, \' \'  AS LagInd, MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_SGMNT_ID AS SegmentNumber, \' \'  AS EnrollmentSource, MMR.EGHP_FLAG AS EGHPFlag, MMR.BASIC_PART_C_PART_A AS PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt, MMR.BASIC_PART_C_PART_B AS PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt, MMR.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_A AS RbtPrtACostSharReduc, MMR.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_B AS RbtPrtBCostSharReduc, MMR.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_A AS RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits, MMR.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_B AS RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits, MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_A AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt, MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_B AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt, MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_A AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt, MMR.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_B AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt, MMR.TOTAL_MA_PART_A AS TotalPrtAMAPymt, MMR.TOTAL_MA_PART_B AS TotalPrtBMAPymt, MMR.ORIG_MDRNZN_ACT_TOTL_PAY_AMT AS TotalMAPayAmt, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_PART_D AS PrtDRAFac, MMR.LOW_INCOME_MI_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeInd, MMR.LOW_INCOME_M_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeMul, MMR.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_PART_D AS PrtDLongTermInstInd, MMR.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_M_PART_D AS PrtDLongTermInstMul, MMR.ORIG_PART_D_PREM_RDCTN_AMT AS RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc, MMR.BASIC_PREM_RED_PART_D AS PrtDBasicPremAmt, MMR.ORIG_PART_D_DRCT_SBSDY_AMT AS PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt, MMR.ORIG_REINSRNC_SBSDY_AMT AS ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt, MMR.ORIG_LOW_INCM_COST_SHRG_AMT AS LICSSubsidyAmt, MMR.TOTAL_PART_D_PAY AS TotalPrtDPymt, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_MON_PART_D AS NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD, MMR.PACE_PREM_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D AS PACEPremAddOn, MMR.PACE_CS_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D AS PACECostSharingAddon, MMR.FRAILTY_FAC_PART_C AS PrtCFrailtyScoreFac, MMR.MSP_RED_FAC_PART_C AS MSPFac, MMR.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_A AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA, MMR.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_B AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB, MMR.MEDICAID_DUAL_STS_CD AS MedicaidDualStsCode, MMR.ORIG_PART_D_CVRG_GAP_DSCNT_AMT AS PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_PART_D AS PrtDRiskAdjtFacType, MMR.DEF_RISK_FAC_CD_PART_D AS DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode, MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_A AS PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt, MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_B AS PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt, MMR.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_D AS PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt, MMR.CLEANUP_ID AS CleanupID, NH.SBSB_ID AS SBSB_ID FROM  PSGL.CMS_MMR_RAW MMR JOIN PSGL.MMR_CO_LOAD NH  ON NH.MEME_HICN = MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AND NH.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR  AND NH.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID = MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBSQL

		TotalPrtAMAPymt_DC = TotalPrtAMAPymt,
		PrtDLowIncomeMul_DC = PrtDLowIncomeMul,
		PACEPremAddOn_DC = PACEPremAddOn,
		Filler_DC = Filler,
